title: Supabase CLI config (CliConfig)
description: The Supabase CLI's local project config document (supabase/config.toml or supabase/config.json).

project_id.description: A string used to distinguish different Supabase projects on the same host. Defaults to the working directory name when running `supabase init`.

port.description: Port to the local Logflare service.

backend.description:
Configure one of the supported backends:

- `postgres`
- `bigquery`

vector_port.description: Port to the local syslog ingest service.

gcp_jwt_path.description: Path to the GCP JWT file.

port.description: Port to use for the API URL.

items.description: Schemas to expose in your API. Tables, views and stored procedures in this schema will get API endpoints.
Extra schemas to add to the search_path of every request.

max_rows.description: The maximum number of rows returned from a view, table, or stored procedure. Limits payload size for accidental or malicious requests.

auto_expose_new_tables.description: Controls whether newly-created tables, views, sequences and functions in the `public` schema by `postgres` are reachable through the Data API roles (`anon`, `authenticated`, `service_role`) without explicit GRANTs. When unset, new entities are auto-exposed, matching the cloud default. Set to `false` to revoke the default Data API privileges so new entities require explicit GRANTs, matching a cloud project with the "Default privileges for new entities" toggle turned off.

enabled.description: Enable HTTPS endpoints locally using a self-signed certificate.

key_path.description: Path to the self-signed certificate private key.

external_url.description: External URL for accessing the API server.

site_url.description: The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used in emails.

additional_redirect_urls.description: A list of exact URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.

jwt_expiry.description: How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 seconds (one week).

signing_keys_path.description: Path to the JWT signing keys file.

enable_refresh_token_rotation.description: If disabled, the refresh token will never expire.

refresh_token_reuse_interval.description: Allows refresh tokens to be reused after expiry, up to the specified interval in seconds.

enable_manual_linking.description: Allow/disallow testing manual linking of accounts.

enable_signup.description: Allow/disallow new user signups to your project.

enable_anonymous_sign_ins.description: Allow/disallow anonymous sign-ins to your project.

minimum_password_length.description: Passwords shorter than this value will be rejected as weak.

runtime.description:
Runtime the compute is built on: `dockerfile` to build the directory's own
Dockerfile, or one of the catalog runtimes (`node`, `deno`). Guessed from
marker files when unset.

size.description:
Instance size, denominated by memory. Each size implies its own vCPU count,
so it is the one dial rather than two.

exposure.description:
How the compute is reached: `public` gives it an internet-facing URL,
`private` keeps it reachable only from inside the project. Every deploy
sends a complete spec, so the value recorded here is what keeps a private
compute private; `--exposure` overrides it for one deploy. Defaults to
`public`.

instances.description:
Number of instances to run. Every deploy sends a complete spec, so a count
recorded here is what keeps a scaled compute scaled; `--instances` overrides
it for one deploy. Defaults to 1.

source.description:
Directory holding the compute's code, relative to the project root, when it
does not live at `supabase/compute/<name>/`.

exclude.description:
Patterns for paths to leave out of the uploaded build context, read the way
`.gitignore` reads them: a pattern without `/` matches that name at any depth,
one with `/` is anchored at the compute's source directory, a trailing `/`
matches directories only, and `**` spans directories. Excluding a directory
excludes everything under it; re-inclusion (`!`) is not supported. Only the
patterns recorded here are excluded, so a compute with no list uploads its source
directory whole.

anyOf.description: Compute-specific configuration keyed by compute name.

compute.description: Enable the experimental compute command family.

stack.description: Use the new local stack backend for start, stop, and status, and for --local targets of the db, migration, test db, gen types, inspect, and pull command families.

enabled.description: Use pg-delta as the schema diff engine for db diff / db pull / db remote commit. Set false to fall back to the legacy migra engine.

declarative_schema_path.description: Directory under supabase/ where declarative schema files are written.

format_options.description: JSON string passed through to pg-delta SQL formatting. When omitted, SQL is formatted with uppercase keywords, indent 2, max width 180, trailing commas, and column/key alignment. Set to "null" to emit raw, unformatted SQL.

Enable the local Supabase Studio dashboard.

port.description: Port to use for Supabase Studio.

api_url.description: External URL of the API server that frontend connects to.

openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key to use for Supabase AI in the Supabase Studio.

runtime.description:
Runtime the compute is built on: `dockerfile` to build the directory's own
Dockerfile, or one of the catalog runtimes (`node`, `deno`). Guessed from
marker files when unset.

size.description:
Instance size, denominated by memory. Each size implies its own vCPU count,
so it is the one dial rather than two.

exposure.description:
How the compute is reached: `public` gives it an internet-facing URL,
`private` keeps it reachable only from inside the project. Every deploy
sends a complete spec, so the value recorded here is what keeps a private
compute private; `--exposure` overrides it for one deploy. Defaults to
`public`.

instances.description:
Number of instances to run. Every deploy sends a complete spec, so a count
recorded here is what keeps a scaled compute scaled; `--instances` overrides
it for one deploy. Defaults to 1.

source.description:
Directory holding the compute's code, relative to the project root, when it
does not live at `supabase/compute/<name>/`.

exclude.description:
Patterns for paths to leave out of the uploaded build context, read the way
`.gitignore` reads them: a pattern without `/` matches that name at any depth,
one with `/` is anchored at the compute's source directory, a trailing `/`
matches directories only, and `**` spans directories. Excluding a directory
excludes everything under it; re-inclusion (`!`) is not supported. Only the
patterns recorded here are excluded, so a compute with no list uploads its source
directory whole.

anyOf.description: Compute-specific configuration keyed by compute name.

compute.description: Enable the experimental compute command family.

stack.description: Use the new local stack backend for start, stop, and status, and for --local targets of the db, migration, test db, gen types, inspect, and pull command families.

orioledb_version.description: Deprecated: use `db.orioledb_version` instead. Postgres storage engine version for OrioleDB.

enabled.description: Use pg-delta as the schema diff engine for db diff / db pull / db remote commit. Set false to fall back to the legacy migra engine.

declarative_schema_path.description: Directory under supabase/ where declarative schema files are written.

format_options.description: JSON string passed through to pg-delta SQL formatting. When omitted, SQL is formatted with uppercase keywords, indent 2, max width 180, trailing commas, and column/key alignment. Set to "null" to emit raw, unformatted SQL.
